task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the left to manipulate and dissect a thin, translucent, web-like membrane of tissue spanning the center of the frame. The background consists of glistening, moist, pinkish-red visceral tissue with visible blood vessels and small pools of dark red blood. The instrument, featuring a metallic shaft and a fine, pointed tip, carefully grasps and pulls the membrane, causing it to stretch and tear, revealing more of the underlying vascularized tissue. As the dissection progresses, the membrane is pulled taut and then retracts, exposing a deeper layer of tissue with a more pronounced reddish hue and a slightly different texture. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective surfaces of the internal anatomy.

Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the left to manipulate and dissect a thin, translucent, web-like membrane of tissue spanning the center of the frame. The background consists of glistening, moist, pinkish-red visceral tissue with visible blood vessels and small pools of dark red blood. The instrument, featuring a metallic shaft and a fine, pointed tip, carefully grasps and pulls the membrane, causing it to stretch and tear, revealing more of the underlying vascularized tissue. As the dissection progresses, the membrane is pulled taut and then retracts, exposing a deeper layer of tissue with a more pronounced reddish hue and a slightly different texture. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective surfaces of the internal anatomy.

prompt.task_text:
Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the left to manipulate and dissect a thin, translucent, web-like membrane of tissue spanning the center of the frame. The background consists of glistening, moist, pinkish-red visceral tissue with visible blood vessels and small pools of dark red blood. The instrument, featuring a metallic shaft and a fine, pointed tip, carefully grasps and pulls the membrane, causing it to stretch and tear, revealing more of the underlying vascularized tissue. As the dissection progresses, the membrane is pulled taut and then retracts, exposing a deeper layer of tissue with a more pronounced reddish hue and a slightly different texture. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective surfaces of the internal anatomy.

A close-up laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the left to manipulate and dissect a thin, translucent, web-like membrane of tissue spanning the center of the frame. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective surfaces of the internal anatomy.

prompt.task_text:
Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the left to manipulate and dissect a thin, translucent, web-like membrane of tissue spanning the center of the frame. The background consists of glistening, moist, pinkish-red visceral tissue with visible blood vessels and small pools of dark red blood. The instrument, featuring a metallic shaft and a fine, pointed tip, carefully grasps and pulls the membrane, causing it to stretch and tear, revealing more of the underlying vascularized tissue. As the dissection progresses, the membrane is pulled taut and then retracts, exposing a deeper layer of tissue with a more pronounced reddish hue and a slightly different texture. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective surfaces of the internal anatomy.
